label: The arithmetic mean: x-bar equals one over n times the sum of the observations
Sample standard deviation: s equals the square root of one over n minus one times the sum of squared deviations from the mean
Standardised score: z sub i equals x sub i minus x-bar, divided by s
Coefficient of variation: CV equals s divided by x-bar, times one hundred percent
Affine transformation: x prime equals a plus b times x
Under an affine transformation the mean shifts and scales, x-bar prime equals a plus b x-bar, while the standard deviation scales by the absolute value of b
